port.description: The TCP port number for the tangd service.

server_args.description: Arguments passed to the server, typically the directory for key storage.

socket_type.description: The socket type (stream for TCP, dgram for UDP).

user.description: The user account under which the service runs.

group.description: The group account under which the service runs.

wait.description: Whether xinetd waits for the server process to terminate (yes) or handles multiple connections (no).

disable.description: Whether the service is disabled (yes) or enabled (no).
